description: This file contains unit tests for the DataReaderV1 class, which reads media segment data from shared memory buffers. It sets up test data, writes it into shared memory, and verifies that DataReaderV1 correctly reads and interprets the data, including both video and audio segments.

classes.name: DataReaderV1Tests
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing the DataReaderV1 class, including setup and teardown routines, and helper methods for writing and reading media data.

methods.name: writeVideoData
methods.description: Writes a video media segment into shared memory using IMediaFrameWriter.

methods.name: readVideoData
methods.description: Reads a video media segment from shared memory using DataReaderV1 and verifies its contents.

methods.name: writeAudioData
methods.description: Writes an audio media segment into shared memory.

methods.name: readAudioData
methods.description: Reads an audio media segment from shared memory using DataReaderV1 and verifies its contents.
